highlights.title_zh: braindecode 新增 NEMARDataset：直接从 NEMAR Zarr 流式读取公开数据集
highlights.title_en: braindecode Adds NEMARDataset to Stream Public Datasets From the NEMAR Zarr Copy
highlights.brief: braindecode 合并 #1439：新增 **NEMARDataset**，可从 **NEMAR 的 Zarr 服务副本**按需流式读取数据，而不必先整包下载再解压——对动辄几十 GB 的公开 EEG 数据集，这是「先试一下」与「不敢碰」的区别。同批的 #1493 更进一步：**记录基础模型预训练语料**，并新增 `check_pretraining_overlap` 用于检查预训练数据与评测集是否重叠。两条合起来正好对应社区眼下最痛的两件事：公开数据难用、以及「你的 SOTA 是不是见过测试集」。对做 EEG 基础模型或跨数据集基准的团队，建议把语料记录与重叠检查纳入实验流程，而不是事后被质疑再补。

highlights.title_zh: braindecode 修 BENDR 输出与预训练参考不一致，以及 MaxNormLinear 约束错维度
highlights.title_en: braindecode Fixes BENDR Output Mismatch and MaxNormLinear Constraining the Wrong Axis
highlights.brief: braindecode 同一天修了两处「形状对、能跑、但语义错」的模型 bug：**#1498 让 BENDR contextualizer 的输出与预训练参考一致**（此前加载官方权重后前向结果对不上参考实现，等于迁移学习从错误的特征空间出发）；**#1476 修 `MaxNormLinear` 约束了输入列而不是输出单元**（权重归一化作用在错轴）。这类 bug 不会报错，只会让微调结果莫名偏低或方差变大，通常被归咎于「数据不够」。用 BENDR 或 MaxNorm 做过迁移/微调的实验，建议升级后重跑并对比特征统计（均值/方差/维度）是否与参考实现吻合；若差异明显，之前的结论需要重新审视。

highlights.title_zh: TorchEEG 让常量通道的归一化保持有限值，并修扩散采样与工具默认值
highlights.title_en: TorchEEG Keeps Normalisation Finite for Constant Channels and Fixes Diffusion Sampling
highlights.brief: TorchEEG 在 11-01 合并 4 个修复，最实用的是 **#337：常量通道的归一化保持有限值**。真实记录里「某通道方差为 0」（电极脱落、放大器饱和、被屏蔽）非常常见，而 z-score 一遇到 0 方差就会产出 **inf/NaN**，随后污染整个 batch、让训练损失直接崩掉，且现象常被误判为「学习率问题」。同批还修了#338 速度扩散采样与工具默认值、#336 镜像源模块并强制 CPU 测试覆盖、#194 在内存数据集中保留字符串 metadata ID。对用 TorchEEG 做大规模训练/扩散模型的团队，建议升级后检查数据管线里是否已对常量通道做过滤或加保护。

items.title_zh: braindecode 新增 NEMARDataset：直接从 NEMAR Zarr 流式读取公开数据集
items.title_en: braindecode Adds NEMARDataset to Stream Public Datasets From the NEMAR Zarr Copy
bullets_zh: #1439 新增 **NEMARDataset**，可从 NEMAR 的 **Zarr 服务副本**按需流式读取数据——不必先整包下载再本地解压。
对公开数据基准与预训练，这大幅降低「试一个数据集要下几十 GB」的门槛；同批 #1493 还记录**基础模型预训练语料**并新增 `check_pretraining_overlap`（检查预训练与评测集是否重叠）。
两者结合的意义：既能更容易地用公开数据，也能更容易证明「评测集没被预训练污染」。
bullets_en: #1439 adds NEMARDataset, streaming data on demand from NEMAR's Zarr serving copy instead of downloading and unpacking whole datasets first.
For public benchmarks and pretraining this removes the tens-of-gigabytes barrier to trying a dataset; #1493 also records foundation-model pretraining corpora and adds check_pretraining_overlap.
Together they make public data easier to use and make it easier to show that evaluation sets were not contaminated by pretraining.
items.brief: braindecode 合并 #1439：新增 **NEMARDataset**，可从 **NEMAR 的 Zarr 服务副本**按需流式读取数据，而不必先整包下载再解压——对动辄几十 GB 的公开 EEG 数据集，这是「先试一下」与「不敢碰」的区别。同批的 #1493 更进一步：**记录基础模型预训练语料**，并新增 `check_pretraining_overlap` 用于检查预训练数据与评测集是否重叠。两条合起来正好对应社区眼下最痛的两件事：公开数据难用、以及「你的 SOTA 是不是见过测试集」。对做 EEG 基础模型或跨数据集基准的团队，建议把语料记录与重叠检查纳入实验流程，而不是事后被质疑再补。
items.brief_en: braindecode merged #1439 adding NEMARDataset, which streams data on demand from NEMAR's Zarr serving copy instead of downloading whole datasets — the difference between trying a public dataset and avoiding it. #1493 also records foundation-model pretraining corpora and adds check_pretraining_overlap, addressing hard-to-use data and SOTA that may have seen the test set.

items.why_valuable: 流式读取免整包下载，并配套预训练语料记录与重叠检查，直击数据污染质疑。

items.title_zh: braindecode 修 BENDR 输出与预训练参考不一致，以及 MaxNormLinear 约束错维度
items.title_en: braindecode Fixes BENDR Output Mismatch and MaxNormLinear Constraining the Wrong Axis
bullets_zh: #1498：**BENDR contextualizer 的输出与预训练参考不一致**——加载官方权重后前向结果对不上参考实现，等于迁移学习从错误的特征空间开始。
#1476：**`MaxNormLinear` 约束的是输入列而非输出单元**，权重归一化作用在错误轴上，模型容量与稳定性都受影响。
两个都属于「形状对、能跑、但语义错」类 bug；用 BENDR 或 MaxNorm 做迁移/微调的实验结论建议重跑。
bullets_en: #1498: the BENDR contextualizer output did not match the pretrained reference, so loading official weights started transfer learning from the wrong feature space.
#1476: MaxNormLinear constrained input columns instead of output units, applying weight normalisation along the wrong axis and changing capacity and stability.
Both are shape-correct, runnable, semantically wrong bugs; re-run transfer or fine-tuning experiments built on BENDR or MaxNorm.
items.brief: braindecode 同一天修了两处「形状对、能跑、但语义错」的模型 bug：**#1498 让 BENDR contextualizer 的输出与预训练参考一致**（此前加载官方权重后前向结果对不上参考实现，等于迁移学习从错误的特征空间出发）；**#1476 修 `MaxNormLinear` 约束了输入列而不是输出单元**（权重归一化作用在错轴）。这类 bug 不会报错，只会让微调结果莫名偏低或方差变大，通常被归咎于「数据不够」。用 BENDR 或 MaxNorm 做过迁移/微调的实验，建议升级后重跑并对比特征统计（均值/方差/维度）是否与参考实现吻合；若差异明显，之前的结论需要重新审视。
items.brief_en: braindecode fixed two shape-correct but semantically wrong bugs: #1498 makes the BENDR contextualizer match its pretrained reference, since loading official weights previously started transfer learning from the wrong feature space; #1476 fixes MaxNormLinear constraining input columns rather than output units. Neither raises an error, so weak fine-tuning was easily blamed on data.
items.raw_excerpt: PRs merged 2026-11-01: "FIX BENDR contextualizer output to match the pretrained reference (#1498)" 04:32Z; "FIX MaxNormLinear constraining input columns instead of output units (#1476)" 04:40Z; "FIX get_metadata crashing on datasets without description (#1483)" 04:39Z.
items.why_valuable: 权重加载后与参考实现不一致、归一化作用错轴，都会让微调结论静默偏移。

items.title_zh: TorchEEG 让常量通道的归一化保持有限值，并修扩散采样与工具默认值
items.title_en: TorchEEG Keeps Normalisation Finite for Constant Channels and Fixes Diffusion Sampling
bullets_zh: #337「Keep normalization finite for **constant channels**」：某通道方差为 0 时，z-score/归一化会产出 inf/NaN 并污染整批数据。
#338 修速度扩散采样与工具函数默认值；#336 镜像源模块并强制 CPU 测试覆盖；#194 在内存数据集中保留字符串 metadata ID。
常量通道在真实记录里很常见（脱落、饱和、屏蔽），处置不当会让一个坏通道毁掉整批训练。
bullets_en: #337 keeps normalisation finite for constant channels: when a channel has zero variance, z-scoring would emit inf or NaN and poison the whole batch.
#338 fixes velocity diffusion sampling and utility defaults, #336 mirrors source modules with enforced CPU test coverage, and #194 preserves string metadata IDs in memory datasets.
Constant channels are common in real recordings (detached, saturated, masked), and one mishandled channel can ruin an entire training batch.
items.brief: TorchEEG 在 11-01 合并 4 个修复，最实用的是 **#337：常量通道的归一化保持有限值**。真实记录里「某通道方差为 0」（电极脱落、放大器饱和、被屏蔽）非常常见，而 z-score 一遇到 0 方差就会产出 **inf/NaN**，随后污染整个 batch、让训练损失直接崩掉，且现象常被误判为「学习率问题」。同批还修了#338 速度扩散采样与工具默认值、#336 镜像源模块并强制 CPU 测试覆盖、#194 在内存数据集中保留字符串 metadata ID。对用 TorchEEG 做大规模训练/扩散模型的团队，建议升级后检查数据管线里是否已对常量通道做过滤或加保护。
items.brief_en: TorchEEG merged four fixes on Nov 1, the most practical being #337: normalisation now stays finite for constant channels. Zero-variance channels (detached, saturated or masked electrodes) are common, and z-scoring them yields inf or NaN that poisons the batch and collapses training, usually misdiagnosed as a learning-rate problem. #338 fixes diffusion sampling defaults.
items.raw_excerpt: PRs merged 2026-11-01: "Keep normalization finite for constant channels (#337)" 09:26Z; "Fix velocity diffusion sampling and utility defaults (#338)" 09:31Z; "Mirror source modules and enforce CPU test coverage (#336)" 09:37Z; "Preserve string metadata IDs in memory datasets (#194)" 09:21Z.
items.why_valuable: 零方差通道会让 z-score 产出 inf/NaN 并污染整批，常被误判为学习率问题。

items.title_zh: NeuroKit2 发布 0.3.0：RR 窗口、RSA 与呼吸衍生指标的一批修正
items.title_en: NeuroKit2 0.3.0: Fixes Across RR Windows, RSA and Respiratory Derivatives
bullets_zh: v0.3.0 距上一版 v0.2.13（3 月）已 8 个月，本次合入 #1179 主发布与一批修正。
具体包括：**在每个 SDANN 窗口内保留最后一个 RR 间期**（#1213）、`hrv_rsa()` 的 RSA_PorgesBohrer 改为基于**心跳周期**计算、`rsp_rvt()` 把 `sampling_rate` 正确传入呼吸检测。
这些函数是生理信号流水线的基础件；窗口边界与采样率漏传都会让 HRV/呼吸指标系统性偏移而不报错。
bullets_en: v0.3.0 lands eight months after v0.2.13, folding in the #1179 main release plus a batch of fixes.
Specifically: keep the last RR interval inside each SDANN window (#1213), compute RSA_PorgesBohrer on heart period in hrv_rsa(), and pass sampling_rate into breath detection in rsp_rvt().
These are the building blocks of physiological pipelines; window-edge and sampling-rate slips shift HRV and respiratory metrics systematically without any error.
items.brief: NeuroKit2 发布 **0.3.0**（距 v0.2.13 八个月），合入 #1179 主发布与一批基础函数修正：**在每个 SDANN 窗口内保留最后一个 RR 间期**（#1213，窗口边界少一跳会系统性低估 SDANN）、`hrv_rsa()` 的 RSA_PorgesBohrer 改为基于**心跳周期**计算、`rsp_rvt()` 把 `sampling_rate` 正确传入呼吸检测。这类问题的共同点是**不报错**：窗口切错或采样率漏传，指标只是悄悄偏一点，直到跨研究对比时才发现对不上。对用 NeuroKit2 做 HRV/呼吸衍生分析的团队，建议升级后对同一份数据重算关键指标并与旧版比对差额，再据此决定是否需要重跑既有结论。
items.brief_en: NeuroKit2 released 0.3.0 eight months after v0.2.13, folding in the main #1179 release plus fixes: keep the last RR interval inside each SDANN window (#1213), compute RSA_PorgesBohrer on heart period in hrv_rsa(), and pass sampling_rate into breath detection in rsp_rvt(). Such slips never raise errors — metrics just drift until cross-study comparisons fail.
items.raw_excerpt: Release v0.3.0 (2026-11-01T10:20:17Z): "[Fix] Keep the last RR interval inside each SDANN window (#1213)"; "0.3.0 (#1179)". Same-day commits: "Merge #1233: [Fix] rsp_rvt(): pass sampling_rate to breath detection" 08:49Z; "Merge #1231: [Fix] hrv_rsa(): compute RSA_PorgesBohrer on heart period" 08:49Z.
items.why_valuable: 窗口边界与采样率漏传不报错，只让 HRV/呼吸指标系统性偏移。

items.title_zh: EEGDash 标记「MNE 读出的量级不合理」通道，并修正 nV/pV 头部缩放
items.title_en: EEGDash Flags Channels MNE Reads at Implausible Scale and Fixes nV/pV Headers
bullets_zh: #511：对 **MNE 读出的量级明显不合理**的通道打标记，并修正以 **nV/pV** 声明单位的 EDF 头部缩放。
单位声明错（把 nV 当 µV）会让幅度差 1000 倍，进而破坏伪迹阈值、频带功率与跨数据集比较——且不会报错。
对入库/分析流水线，这类「标记而不是静默修正」的做法更安全：先暴露、再决定是否重标定。
bullets_en: #511 flags channels that MNE reads at an implausible scale and corrects EDF headers declaring nV or pV units.
A wrong unit declaration (treating nV as µV) shifts amplitudes by 1000x, breaking artefact thresholds, band power and cross-dataset comparisons without any error.
Flagging rather than silently rescaling is the safer choice for ingestion pipelines: surface it, then decide whether to recalibrate.
items.brief: EEGDash 合并 #511：**标记「MNE 读出的量级不合理」的通道**，并修正以 **nV/pV** 声明单位的 EDF 头部缩放。EEG 数据里单位声明错误是经典陷阱——把 nV 当 µV 会让幅度差 **1000 倍**，伪迹阈值、频带功率、跨数据集归一化全部被带偏，而代码不会报任何错。这个 PR 的处理方式值得借鉴：**先标记、不静默修正**，让人决定是否重标定，避免把「可能是记录问题」的数据悄悄改成「看起来正常」。对做大规模数据入库或跨数据集元分析的团队，建议在流水线里消费这些标记并统计出现频率。
items.brief_en: EEGDash merged #511 flagging channels MNE reads at an implausible scale and correcting EDF headers that declare nV or pV units. Misdeclared units are a classic EEG trap — treating nV as µV shifts amplitudes by 1000x and skews artefact thresholds, band power and cross-dataset normalisation with no error raised. Flagging instead of silently rescaling keeps a human in the loop.
items.raw_excerpt: Commit d4a6823124, 2026-11-01T04:28Z: "fix(edf): flag channels MNE reads at an implausible scale; scale nV/pV headers (#511)". Repo: eegdash/EEGDash.
items.why_valuable: 单位声明错会让幅度差 1000 倍且不报错，标记而非静默修正更安全。

items.title_zh: 独立开发者 NeuroMI Studio：ADS1299＋ESP32-S3 的非侵入式运动想象解码系统 V1
items.title_en: NeuroMI Studio: An Independent Non-Invasive MI Decoding System on ADS1299 + ESP32-S3
bullets_zh: 硬件沿用自主设计的 **ADS1299＋ESP32-S3** 方案，范式为 **Graz 左右手运动想象**；V1 已集成多通道可视化、频谱分析、**ERD/ERS**、**ICA 伪迹分析**与 **CSP+LDA** 解码。
作者明确说明当前展示的是**软件功能与实验流程**，硬件接入、实时解码与机械臂闭环尚未完成——属阶段性 Demo。
对国内自建 BCI 工具链的个人开发者，这份「范式—分析—解码」串起来的 V1 流程图是少见的完整参考。
bullets_en: The hardware is a self-designed ADS1299 + ESP32-S3 stack with a Graz left/right motor-imagery paradigm; V1 already integrates multi-channel viewing, spectral analysis, ERD/ERS, ICA artefact analysis and CSP+LDA decoding.
The author states plainly that this demo shows software features and the experimental flow, with hardware integration, real-time decoding and robot-arm closed loop still pending.
For independent developers building a BCI toolchain in China, this end-to-end V1 flow (paradigm, analysis, decoding) is a rare complete reference.
items.brief: B站独立开发者「超人归来ray」发布 **NeuroMI Studio V1**：硬件基于自主设计的 **ADS1299＋ESP32-S3**，范式用 **Graz 左右手运动想象**，软件已集成多通道可视化、频谱分析、**ERD/ERS**、**ICA 伪迹分析**与 **CSP+LDA** 解码。作者写得很实在：当前展示的是**软件功能与实验流程**，硬件接入、实时解码与机械臂闭环还没做。对国内自建 BCI 工具链的个人或小团队，这份「采集硬件→范式→分析→解码」串起来的 V1 是少见的完整参考；也值得注意它与我们近期收录的开源 ADS1299 硬件（YuEEG、PiEEG）指向同一条低成本路线。
items.brief_en: EEGDash merged #511 flagging channels MNE reads at an implausible scale and correcting EDF headers that declare nV or pV units. Misdeclared units are a classic EEG trap — treating nV as µV shifts amplitudes by 1000x and skews artefact thresholds, band power and cross-dataset normalisation with no error raised. Flagging instead of silently rescaling keeps a human in the loop.
items.raw_excerpt: 「NeuroMI Studio 第一个小版本 Demo 测试。基于自主设计的 ADS1299 + ESP32-S3 硬件架构方案，采用 Graz 左右手运动想象范式，集成多通道 EEG 信号可视化、频谱分析、ERD/ERS、ICA 伪迹分析及 CSP + LDA 运动想象解码等功能。」「目前主要展示 V1 版本的软件功能与实验流程，后续将逐步推进硬件接入、实时解码及脑机接口与机械臂的闭环联动控制。」
items.why_valuable: 把采集硬件→范式→分析→解码串成完整 V1，并诚实标注尚未实现的部分。

items.title_zh: MNE-Python 修 trame-pyvista 兼容（0.3 发布后崩溃）
items.title_en: MNE-Python Fixes trame-pyvista Compatibility After Its 0.3 Release
bullets_zh: #14474 修 **trame-pyvista 0.3 发布后导致的渲染失败**（对应 pyvista issue 9520），让交互式三维渲染在后端升级后仍可用。
作者说明待 conda-forge 的 feedstock PR 落地后，会把 `trame-pyvista` 加入 `pip-pre` 测试矩阵，避免同类升级再次漏检。
对依赖 `Brain` 交互视图或 notebook 内三维渲染的团队，建议升级后实测一次「打开→旋转→截图」链路。
bullets_en: #14474 fixes rendering failures after the trame-pyvista 0.3 release (pyvista issue 9520), keeping interactive 3D rendering working after the backend upgrade.
The author will add trame-pyvista to the pip-pre test matrix once the conda-forge feedstock PR lands, so similar upgrades are caught automatically.
Teams relying on Brain interactive views or notebook 3D rendering should exercise an open-rotate-screenshot path after upgrading.
items.brief: MNE-Python 合并 #14474：修 **trame-pyvista 0.3 发布后导致的渲染失败**（对应 pyvista issue 9520），让交互式三维渲染在后端升级后仍可用。这类「上游一升级、下游就崩」的兼容问题对使用者最常见——表现是打开三维视图报错或白屏，而问题并不在 MNE 自己。作者同时说明：等 conda-forge 的 feedstock PR 落地，会把 `trame-pyvista` 加进 `pip-pre` 测试矩阵，让同类升级被自动捕获，这比逐个救火更值得肯定。对依赖 `Brain` 交互视图或 notebook 内三维渲染的团队，建议升级后实测一次「打开→旋转→截图」全链路。
items.brief_en: Bilibili developer 超人归来ray released NeuroMI Studio V1: self-designed ADS1299 + ESP32-S3 hardware, a Graz left/right motor-imagery paradigm, and software covering multi-channel viewing, spectral analysis, ERD/ERS, ICA artefact analysis and CSP+LDA decoding. The author states that hardware integration, real-time decoding and the robot loop are still pending — a rare end-to-end V1.
items.raw_excerpt: PR #14474: "Fix for trame-pyvista — Fixes failure in https://github.com/pyvista/pyvista/issues/9520 due to 0.3 release. Once https://github.com/conda-forge/trame-pyvista-feedstock/pull/11 lands I'll add `trame-pyvista` to `pip-pre` to m[atrix]". Merged 2026-11-01T01:45Z.
items.why_valuable: 上游 trame-pyvista 升级会让三维渲染报错/白屏，且已计划纳入测试矩阵。
